title: grafana-ui testing: Jest unit tests + Playwright-driven Storybook for visual/interaction
answers: How do I run visual/interaction tests for grafana-ui?
Where do Storybook e2e specs live?
body: Unit tests: root `jest.config.js` (testEnvironment 'jsdom', ts-jest transform) with @testing-library/react + jest-dom + user-event; tests sit beside the component, e.g. `src/components/Icon/Icon.test.tsx` (RTL render + screen.getByTestId). Visual/interaction: Storybook under `packages/grafana-ui/.storybook/` is driven by Playwright (not Chromatic) — `playwright.storybook.config.ts` boots `yarn storybook` on localhost:9001 and runs specs under `e2e-playwright/storybook/` (e.g. verify.spec.ts hitting a story URL like `?path=/story/inputs-button--basic`). There's also a `storybook:test` package.json script using @storybook/test-runner as an alternative runner.
